bare.label: asker with no numbers
bare.state: An open-source multi-asset trading research platform emits daily picks across CRYPTO, EQUITY, ETF, FOREX, COMMODITY, FUTURES and BOND. Its audit ledger measures every class net of trading costs. The operator wants to know which class, if any, deserves a forward-test budget.

evidence.label: same question with the measured ledger
evidence.state: An open-source multi-asset trading research platform emits daily picks across CRYPTO, EQUITY, ETF, FOREX, COMMODITY, FUTURES and BOND. Measured net-of-cost results from its audit ledger: CRYPTO n=6836 mean -0.380%/trade, 95% CI [-0.647,-0.114], verdict KILL; EQUITY n=955 +0.098%, CI [-0.516,+0.720], WEAK; ETF n=589 -0.003%, CI [-0.420,+0.450], WEAK; FOREX n=264 WEAK; COMMODITY n=48, policy-clean PF 0.29, KILL after a COT look-ahead correction; BOND n=37 below the n floor; FUTURES n=4. Search space already tested: 629 CRYPTO strategy cells, 19 EQUITY, 12 ETF, 18 FOREX, 9 COMMODITY, 3 FUTURES, 2 BOND. Promotion requires 100+ forward rows, a net CI excluding zero at twice the measured slippage, and an information ratio of 0.5 or better against a matched benchmark leg.

crypto_aggregate_kill_justified.instructions: Judge whether a class whose aggregate net expectancy is negative with a CI excluding zero should be closed to further strategy work, or whether a subset edge could still exist within it.

criteria.true: The negative aggregate justifies stopping work on the whole class
criteria.false: A subset edge could still exist, so the class should not be closed on the aggregate alone

any_class_worth_forward_budget.instructions: Judge whether any of these classes is a defensible forward-test candidate given the measured numbers.

criteria.true: At least one class is a defensible forward-test candidate
criteria.false: None of the classes is a defensible forward-test candidate

longer_holding_period_is_the_fix.instructions: Judge whether extending holding periods from intraday/short-horizon to 20-60 days is the change most likely to reveal a real edge that the current tests hide.

criteria.true: Longer holding periods are the highest-leverage fix
criteria.false: Something other than holding period is the higher-leverage fix

panel_consensus_is_evidence.instructions: Judge whether agreement among several language models about which asset class has an edge constitutes evidence about the edge.

criteria.true: Model agreement constitutes evidence about the edge
criteria.false: Model agreement is not evidence about the edge
